figure: Fig. S4 | Either half of a condition library names the same owner
randomness: none (halves by SHA-256 of the condition identifiers)
transformation: Product-forming pairs of each array (gate of the full array). Conditions ordered by the SHA-256 of their identifiers and dealt alternately into halves A and B. In each half and in the full library, both role shares by the estimator of Fig. 1d (condition pattern after an intercept and slope on the condition means; share of a role = mean product of the patterns of pairs sharing only that molecule / mean pattern variance). Margin = share of the full-array owner minus share of its partner; a half names the other role when its margin is below zero.
